verdict.rationale: Name.com supports bulk-style operations in specific areas—checking up to 50 domains at once via API, bulk search/bulk changes to nameservers across many domains via UI (community confirms selecting 50 domains at once), and webhooks for tracking status changes—but there's no evidence of a general-purpose bulk API for arbitrary operations (e.g., bulk DNS record creation, bulk transfers, bulk renewals) that an AI-native user could drive programmatically at scale. missing for 10: documented bulk endpoints for DNS/renewals/transfers beyond the 50-domain availability check, batch/async job API for large-scale operations, and independent confirmation of bulk API reliability at scale.
